name: Euro Leder Fashion Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Euro Leder Fashion Ltd manufactures Leather Garments and leather accessories.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ELFL is an export-oriented unit and is engaged in the manufacturing of leather garments and finished leathers. The company’s manufacturing processes primarily involve basic cutting and stitching of leather garments.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -21.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.08% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.40 Cr.
